_comment: Engine registry for the multi-engine study. Endpoints are localhost defaults -- EDIT to your deployment (or pass --query-endpoint/--update-endpoint to run_engine.py). 'writable' engines run property paths (iterative INSERT); 'readonly' engines run non-path CONSTRUCTs only. 'reification' lists the schemes the engine supports (SPARQL_Star needs 'rdfstar': true).

graphdb.note: RDF4J-based; CircuitRun uses the native RDF4J HTTP repository protocol. /statements is an RDF statement route, not a generic form-encoded SPARQL Update endpoint.

fuseki.role: baseline-shared with SPARQLprov; already in pilot/tools/apache-jena-fuseki-5.4.0
fuseki.note: Apache Jena Fuseki. Start with --update; GSP bulk endpoint at /ds/data.

qlever.note: SPARQL 1.1 Update IS supported since ~2025 (POST application/sparql-update, needs access-token + --persist-updates) -> writable in principle. BUT its update path is slow (~10ms/op) and OOM-prone at even ~8M triples (github ad-freiburg/qlever#2481), so we keep readonly=true (-> CIRCUIT_READONLY=1) as the SAFE DEFAULT for the high-volume iterative path protocol. Bulk-build the index offline; run non-path here. Paths at scale: frontier-restricted / VALUES-inline route (README, gap G1), NOT raw bulk UPDATE.

millenniumdb.role: property-path SOTA (WDBench) -- ideal path target once read-only paths land
millenniumdb.note: READ-ONLY: bulk import; non-path only for now. Check the build exposes a SPARQL endpoint (newer versions do).

virtuoso.note: Open-source edition; updates may need /sparql-auth + credentials.
